differences: The paper says the modal number of plays is 1; in the deposit it is 2 (234991 cookies against 230295 with one play).

The paper's explore/exploit r = .59 is reproduced (0.592) with the pairing of the deposited script (variance of plays 6-10 with mean of plays 1-5); the pairing the paper's text describes and the bootstrap script uses (variance of plays 1-5 with mean of plays 6-10) gives r = 0.638.
